children.value: > Fact From Story: Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is on trial for seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story: SBF has pleaded not-guilty to some seven charges of fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story: FTX was a fraud “from the start,” the Securities and Exchange Commission alleges
> > > Fact From Story: FTX’s collapse triggered concerns surrounding FTX’s liquidity after CoinDesk published a copy of Alameda’s balance sheet.
> > > Fact From Story: The Securities and Exchange Commission alleges a “multi-billion-dollar deficiency caused by his own misappropriation of customer funds.”
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Misappropriating funds and having liquidity problems are signs of fraud.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: If someone is on trial, then a crime is suspected to have been committed.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Fraud and conspiracy are crimes.
